$comment: Authenticated perf budgets (server response time, observed TTFB + first byte over local HTTPS). Journeys: member-rsvp (GET /e/:key with a member session cookie: the personalized detail read with attendees/RSVP/waitlist) and moderator-admin (GET /admin/events with a moderator session cookie: the bounded list read behind adminGuard). samples is at least five per journey for calibration. Ceilings are initial fail-closed budgets for the disposable-CI local worker (low-hundreds ms measured); they are deliberately generous to absorb runner variance while still catching multi-second regressions (unindexed scans, N+1 reads, upstream-coupled refresh). Tightening is follow-up work; never relax a ceiling to make CI green. member-rsvp path names the browser-smoke seeded published event from e2e/seed.mjs; AUTH_PERF_EVENT_KEY overrides it when the seed changes.
